title: ‘Good luck’: Remulla skips France trip, taunts ‘hiding’ PH solons

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla on Friday wished the Filipinos ‘hiding’ in France good luck amid protests in the foreign country. In a press conference, Remulla announced the cancellation of his trip to France, which was set to seek out fugitive former Rep. Zaldy Co and mother-son lawmakers Sen. Loren Legarda and Cong.
